'''Fixer 103''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he was on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], negotiating with Captain [[Lieber]].
